title: Address Villas - Hillcrest
about:
Nestled within the green heart of Dubai, Address Villas - Hillcrest offers a first-of-its-kind lifestyle experience in Dubai Hills Estate. This exclusive collection of five-bedroom luxury villas is developed by Emaar Properties and branded under the prestigious Address Hotels + Resorts. Surrounded by verdant landscapes and footsteps from Dubai Hills Park, the community strikes a harmonious balance between urban convenience and natural serenity.


Each residence at Address Hillcrest Villas by Emaar is thoughtfully designed to reflect timeless sophistication with contemporary elegance. Residents enjoy access to a wide range of world-class amenities, including a community centre, a fully equipped gym, a multi-purpose room, a swimming pool, and a dedicated kids' pool. With its strategic location, superior design, and the trusted legacy of Emaar, Address Hillcrest Villas stands as an exceptional choice for refined family living in one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighbourhoods.

location_tile.title: A Serene Retreat at the Heart of Dubai’s Greenest Community
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Address Hillcrest Villas at Dubai Hills Estate enjoy a distinguished location within one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods. Nestled near Al Khail Road (E44), this prestigious address offers seamless access to the city’s key destinations while maintaining a tranquil, park-like setting. Residents benefit from proximity to top-tier schools, healthcare facilities, and Dubai Hills Mall, all surrounded by expansive landscaped spaces and exclusive amenities.

  • 6 Minutes – Dubai Hills Golf Club
  • 7 Minutes – Dubai Hills Park
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai Miracle Garden 
  • 15 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 17 Minutes – Dubai Marina
  • 20 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
